cold_email.subject: Interest in Educator, Full Time / STONERIDGE MALL — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear lululemon Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Educator, Full Time / STONERIDGE MALL opportunity with lululemon at lululemon.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Station Trainer - Ramp — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Sun Country Airlines Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Station Trainer - Ramp opportunity with Sun Country Airlines at Sun Country Airlines.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Research Associate - 2026 Spring Graduates Apply Here — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Murphy Research Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Research Associate - 2026 Spring Graduates Apply Here opportunity with Murphy Research at Murphy Research.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Customer Education Specialist — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Crossbeam Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Customer Education Specialist opportunity with Crossbeam at Crossbeam.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Product Operations Educator (PM) / Tysons Corner — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear lululemon Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Product Operations Educator (PM) / Tysons Corner opportunity with lululemon at lululemon.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Program Coordinator - NLCP — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear VOA Illinois Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Program Coordinator - NLCP opportunity with VOA Illinois at VOA Illinois.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Production Lab Tech - Optical Inventory (NEW 3-DAY SHIFTS & differential pay!) — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear National Vision Inc. Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Production Lab Tech - Optical Inventory (NEW 3-DAY SHIFTS & differential pay!) opportunity with National Vision Inc. at National Vision Inc..

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Night Youth Mentor - Lava Heights Academy — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Rite of Passage Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Night Youth Mentor - Lava Heights Academy opportunity with Rite of Passage at Rite of Passage.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Bilingual Simulated Patient & Lab Assistant for Home Health Licensing Students — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Abby Care Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Bilingual Simulated Patient & Lab Assistant for Home Health Licensing Students opportunity with Abby Care at Abby Care.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic Platform
jobs.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company co-headquartered in Toronto and San Francisco, with key offices in London, New York City, Montreal, Seoul, Germany and Paris. Join us! ABOUT NORTH: North https://cohere.com/north is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications. WHY THIS ROLE? This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how enterprises harness the power of AI in real-world applications. As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors such as finance, healthcare, and telecommunications. We’re looking for Software Engineers with Applied AI experience who can own the design, build, and deployment of agentic workflows powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), from early prototypes to production-grade AI agents, to deliver concrete business value in enterprise workflows. You’ll work closely with customers on real-world business problems, often building first-of-their-kind agent workflows that integrate LLMs with tools, APIs, and data sources. While our pace is startup-fast, the bar is enterprise-high: agents must be reliable, observable, safe, and auditable from day one. Note: between 20 - 40% travel anticipated. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Work closely with our enterprise customers to translate high-value, ambiguous business problems into well-framed agentic workflows with clear success criteria and evaluation methodologies - Lead the design, build, and delivery of LLM-powered agents that reason, plan, and act across tools, APIs, and sensitive enterprise data sources, with enterprise-grade reliability and performance - Build and ship features for North, our AI workspace platform, working across the full product lifecycle from conceptualization through production - Take ownership of scoping and shaping use cases end-to-end, flexing into whatever technical area the problem demands (including frontend) to drive the most effective solution - Contribute to shared frameworks and patterns that enable consistent, high-quality delivery across customers and teams - Drive clarity in ambiguous situations, build alignment, and raise engineering quality across the organization - Travel up to 20–40% to work on-site with customers and partners YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF: - You have hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade software in Python; you write clean, testable, observable, scalable code - You've built and deployed highly performant RAG and agentic applications, including agents that plan and execute multi-step tasks using patterns like ReAct or Plan-and-Execute - You're deeply familiar with the LLM stack: frontier models, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks - You have a proven ability to build robust evaluation frameworks, moving well beyond trial and error, to measure agent accuracy, safety, and latency - You’re experienced working directly with customers and can lead technical discussions with enterprise stakeholders, translating ambiguous business needs into concrete technical specs - You have experience owning the full scope of a use case end-to-end - You thrive in fast-paced and ambiguous environments and can execute well even when priorities are shifting IT'S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE: - Experience setting architectural standards for AI and agentic systems across distributed teams - Experience flexing into unfamiliar technical areas, such as frontend, when the problem calls for it - Exposure to regulated or sensitive industry environments (finance, healthcare, telecoms) - Experience with enterprise security, compliance, or auditability requirements for AI systems FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly. We have offices in Toronto, San Francisco, New York City, London, Paris, Montreal, and more coming soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

jobs.title: Associate Coordinator/Receptionist - Washington, DC
jobs.description: Career Category Administrative Job Description Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. Associate Coordinator/Receptionist - Level 1 Live What you will do Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. The Associate Coordinator/Receptionist will serve as the welcoming point of contact for Amgen’s Washington, D.C. office. This role is responsible for creating a positive first impression for visitors and staff, coordinating front desk operations, and supporting day-to-day office activities. Responsibilities will include: Front Office Operations – Serve as the first point of contact for guests, visitors, and staff by managing front desk operations, answering and directing calls, and providing exceptional customer service while fostering a professional, inclusive, and welcoming office environment. Off-Site Meeting and Visit Logistics – Coordinate and support logistics for off-site meetings, executive visits, and special events, including the preparation, organization, and secure delivery of materials to ensure successful execution. Office Readiness & Workplace Experience – Prepare and maintain office and shared spaces at the beginning and end of each day, ensuring all areas are clean, organized, fully functional, and ready to support employees and visitors. Facility Support – Coordinate facility maintenance requests, manage office and kitchen supply inventories, place orders as needed, and ensure storage areas remain well-stocked, organized, and operational. Conference Room Coordination – Schedule conference rooms, coordinate meeting logistics, support audio-visual and IT-related requests, and maintain meeting spaces to ensure a seamless and professional experience for all users. Event and Meeting Support – Responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing DC staff lunches, meetings, and small office gatherings in the Washington, DC office, including catering arrangements, event logistics, setup, and cleanup to ensure a seamless and professional experience. Mail and Package Handling – Manage all incoming and outgoing mail and package operations, including receiving, sorting, tracking, and distributing shipments from carriers such as USPS, UPS, and FedEx. Ensure timely, accurate, and secure delivery of correspondence and packages while maintaining organized mailroom processes and supporting office operational needs. Administrative Support – Provide basic day-to-day administrative support to Washington, DC office staff, including coordinating travel, processing expense reports, scheduling conference rooms, managing printing requests, and addressing other operational and administrative needs as they arise. New Hire Onboarding – Coordinate and support new employee onboarding by preparing workspace materials, organizing required resources, and assisting with orientation logistics to ensure a smooth and positive onboarding experience. Safety and Emergency Readiness – Support the Emergency Response Team (ERT) by maintaining and monitoring emergency supplies, assisting with workplace safety and preparedness initiatives, coordinating readiness activities, and helping ensure compliance with established safety protocols and emergency response procedures. Other Duties as Assigned Win What we expect of you We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Associate Coordinator/Receptionist we seek is a motivated professional with these qualifications. Basic Qualifications Associate’s degree OR High school diploma / GED and 2 years administrative experience OR Certification that is directly related to the role and 2 years administrative experience Preferred Qualifications: Good communication and customer service skills Good organizational and time management abilities Comfortable learning new office systems, scheduling tools, and basic technology platforms Demonstrated reliability and attention to detail Ability to work effectively with diverse teams and individuals Thrive What you can expect from us As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way. The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease. cold_email.subject: Interest in Associate Coordinator/Receptionist - Washington, DC — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Amgen Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Associate Coordinator/Receptionist - Washington, DC opportunity with Amgen at Amgen.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Construction Manager, Industrial Compute
jobs.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Compute organization is building the physical infrastructure required to support the next generation of AI systems. We are developing and scaling large, complex data center campuses that integrate high-density compute, power, cooling, networking, and supporting infrastructure at unprecedented speed and scale. The Construction organization is responsible for translating these designs into operating facilities. We work across engineering, infrastructure delivery, procurement, supply chain, commissioning, operations, and external construction partners to safely deliver highly complex data center infrastructure on aggressive schedules. As OpenAI’s infrastructure footprint expands, we are looking for construction leaders who can operate effectively in high-velocity environments, manage large contractor ecosystems, and develop repeatable approaches to delivering increasingly complex facilities. About the Role We are seeking a Senior Construction Manager to lead field execution for large-scale AI data center projects from mobilization through commissioning and operational handoff. This role will serve as a senior construction leader and primary point of contact for general contractors, trade partners, and other external construction organizations. You will be responsible for coordinating multidisciplinary construction activities, driving schedule performance, resolving field issues, and ensuring that infrastructure is delivered safely, efficiently, and to the required technical standards. The role requires someone who is equally comfortable operating at the project level and in the field: reviewing designs for constructability, developing construction sequencing, coordinating thousands of workers and multiple trades, identifying bottlenecks, and making rapid decisions when conditions change. You will work closely with engineering, commissioning, infrastructure delivery, procurement, logistics, and operations teams to accelerate delivery while maintaining a high bar for quality, safety, and reliability. Key Responsibilities - Lead construction execution for large-scale data center campuses and critical infrastructure from site mobilization through commissioning and operational handoff. - Serve as a senior field leader and primary point of contact for general contractors, trade contractors, and construction partners across assigned projects. - Direct large multidisciplinary contractor organizations across electrical, mechanical, structural, civil, controls, networking, and data hall construction activities. - Develop and drive construction sequencing strategies that enable parallel execution across multiple workstreams while maintaining safety, quality, and schedule integrity. - Own construction schedules, progress reporting, critical-path management, and recovery plans for projects operating under aggressive delivery timelines. - Review engineering designs and construction documents for constructability, identifying opportunities to simplify execution, reduce field conflicts, and accelerate installation. - Partner with engineering and design teams to resolve constructability issues before they become field constraints and minimize unnecessary RFIs and rework. - Lead rapid field problem solving across construction, engineering, commissioning, and contractor teams, making decisions that keep projects moving. - Coordinate construction activities with equipment deliveries, logistics, commissioning, energization, and infrastructure readiness requirements. - Establish clear performance expectations for contractors and trade partners, and hold them accountable for safety, schedule, quality, productivity, and execution. - Support contractor selection, onboarding, scope development, and performance management across major construction packages. - Identify construction risks, emerging schedule constraints, resource bottlenecks, and interface issues and develop mitigation strategies before they impact project delivery. - Partner with commissioning teams to ensure systems are installed, tested, and transitioned into operational readiness according to project requirements. - Develop scalable construction processes, reporting mechanisms, and execution standards that can be applied across OpenAI’s growing data center portfolio. - Provide senior leadership with clear visibility into project status, critical risks, contractor performance, schedule confidence, and required decisions. Preferred Skills - 10+ years of experience leading construction delivery for large-scale data centers, industrial facilities, semiconductor facilities, power infrastructure, or other highly complex mission-critical environments. - Demonstrated experience delivering hyperscale or high-density data center infrastructure with significant electrical and mechanical complexity. - Proven ability to lead very large contractor and trade workforces across multiple simultaneous construction workstreams. - Deep understanding of data center construction sequencing, including data halls, electrical distribution, mechanical systems, controls, cooling infrastructure, and supporting site infrastructure. - Strong understanding of constructability and the ability to translate engineering designs into practical, executable field plans. - Experience managing aggressive construction schedules and developing innovative sequencing or parallelization strategies to materially accelerate delivery. - Strong field-based problem-solving skills, with the ability to make sound technical and operational decisions under significant time pressure. - Experience managing general contractors, specialty contractors, vendors, and construction consultants across complex project environments. - Strong understanding of construction project controls, including critical path scheduling, progress measurement, forecasting, productivity, and recovery planning. - Experience leading construction through commissioning, energization, integrated systems testing, and operational handoff. - Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve construction issues directly with field engineers, contractors, and trade partners rather than relying solely on formal escalation processes. - Experience with contractor procurement, bid evaluation, scope development, and contractor performance management. - Strong understanding of construction safety requirements and the ability to maintain a high safety standard across large and rapidly scaling workforces. - Excellent communication skills and the ability to operate effectively with executives, engineers, contractors, vendors, and field personnel. - Experience working in fast-moving environments where priorities, designs, schedules, and execution plans can change rapidly. - Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. - Willingness to spend significant time in the field and travel regularly to active construction sites. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products.
